tcs.tc_title: Browse Traffic and Weather lists cities and allows selection
tcs.test_item: The HU shall display the list of all available cities with traffic/weather data and allow selection of a traffic/weather channel within the list when Traffic & Weather Category is initiated under SiriusXM Browse function
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. At least two cities have traffic and weather data available
tcs.input_test_data: Entry path under test: the Traffic & Weather Category under the SiriusXM Browse function
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the SiriusXM Browse function
2. Initiate the Traffic & Weather Category
3. Read the list displayed
4. Select one traffic and weather channel from the list and read the tuned channel
tcs.expected_result:
1. The SiriusXM Browse function is displayed
2. The Traffic & Weather Category is initiated
3. The cities with traffic and weather data available are listed
4. The HU is tuned to the traffic and weather channel of the selected city
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
